q: Skip-gram vs CBOW: what is each predicting, and how does negative sampling help?
answer: Skip-gram: center→context; CBOW: context→center. Neg sampling turns softmax into binary tasks.

q: What does BERT pretrain (MLM/NSP) and why was NSP later dropped?
answer: MLM bidirectional. NSP weak/leaky; RoBERTa drops it, uses longer docs + more data.

q: Why put a CRF on top of a token classifier for NER?
answer: Models tag transitions (B-PER→I-PER). Viterbi decode; BIO scheme constraints.

q: Seq2seq with attention: what fails without attention on long input?
answer: Fixed vector bottleneck. Attention aligns decoder step to encoder states; coverage for repeats.

q: Pretrain vs fine-tune vs prompt vs RAG for a domain NLP app — pick and justify.
answer: Need parametric knowledge vs freshness vs labels. RAG for changing docs; SFT for style; LoRA for cost.

q: Why subword tokenization instead of word or character for Chinese NLP?
answer: OOV vs sequence length. Subword balances vocab and steps; character-only is long; word needs segmenter.

q: Text classification with 20:1 class imbalance: metrics and training tricks.
answer: PR-AUC / F1 not accuracy. Class weights, focal, threshold tune, resampling, hierarchical labels.

q: HMM vs MEMM vs CRF for sequence labeling: label bias?
answer: HMM generative local; MEMM local-norm label bias; CRF global Z(x). Trade compute vs features.

q: Absolute vs relative vs RoPE positional encodings — length extrapolation?
answer: Sin/cos absolute; relative bias (T5/Shaw); RoPE rotates QK. Extrapolation needs NTK/YaRN or train longer.

q: When is BLEU/ROUGE misleading for summarization or dialogue?
answer: N-gram overlap ≠ factuality. Use QA-fact, entailment, human, task success; cite hallucination cases.
